name: Crusoe Managed Inference
description: Run open-source and fine-tuned models through Crusoe Cloud's OpenAI-compatible inference API, on serverless per-token endpoints or dedicated self-serve deployments.

skills.name: Serverless Inference
skills.description: Sends chat completion requests to hosted open-source models through an OpenAI-compatible API, billed per token.

skills.name: Self-Serve Deployments
skills.description: Deploys dedicated inference endpoints with reserved GPUs, replica control and latency or throughput optimization profiles.

skills.name: Serverless Fine-Tuning
skills.description: Trains LoRA adapters through Serverless Fine-Tuning and serves them on self-serve deployments alongside base models.

skills.name: Inference Metrics
skills.description: Monitors Serverless Inference performance with built-in metrics and a Prometheus-compatible query API.
